question:
The contract booking numbers for three products, I, II, and III, for each quarter of the next year are shown in Table 1-10.

Table 1-10
\begin{tabular}{c|c|c|c|c}
\hline \multirow{2}{*}{ Product } & \multicolumn{4}{|c}{ Quarter } \\
\cline { 2 - 5 } & 1 & 2 & 3 & 4 \\
\hline I & 1500 & 1000 & 2000 & 1200 \\
II & 1500 & 1500 & 1200 & 1500 \\
III & 1000 & 2000 & 1500 & 2500 \\
\hline
\end{tabular}

At the beginning of the first quarter, there is no inventory for any of the three products. It is required to have 150 units of inventory for each product at the end of the fourth quarter. It is known that the factory has 15,000 hours of production time per quarter, and it takes 2, 4, and 3 hours respectively to produce one unit of products I, II, and III. Due to equipment replacement, product I cannot be produced in the second quarter. It is stipulated that if a product cannot be delivered on time, a compensation of $20 per unit per quarter will be paid for products I and II, and $10 for product III. Additionally, for products produced but not delivered in the same quarter, there is a storage cost of $5 per unit per quarter. How should the factory arrange its production to minimize the total compensation and storage costs?

import pyomo.environ as pyo

DATA = {
    # Table 1-10 booking numbers (demand) per product per quarter
    "demand": {
        "I":   {1: 1500, 2: 1000, 3: 2000, 4: 1200},
        "II":  {1: 1500, 2: 1500, 3: 1200, 4: 1500},
        "III": {1: 1000, 2: 2000, 3: 1500, 4: 2500},
    },
    "products": ["I", "II", "III"],
    "quarters": [1, 2, 3, 4],
    # "it takes 2, 4, and 3 hours respectively to produce one unit"
    "hours": {"I": 2, "II": 4, "III": 3},
    # "15,000 hours of production time per quarter"
    "time_capacity": 15000,
    # "there is no inventory ... at the beginning of the first quarter"
    "init_inventory": 0,
    # "150 units of inventory for each product at the end of the fourth quarter"
    "final_inventory": 150,
    # "product I cannot be produced in the second quarter"
    "forbidden": {"I": 2},
    # compensation $20 for I and II, $10 for III per unit per quarter
    "comp": {"I": 20, "II": 20, "III": 10},
    # "storage cost of $5 per unit per quarter"
    "hold": 5,
}


def build_model(data=None):
    d = data or DATA
    P = d["products"]
    T = d["quarters"]

    model = pyo.ConcreteModel()

    model.P = pyo.Set(initialize=P)
    model.T = pyo.Set(initialize=T)
    model.T0 = pyo.Set(initialize=[0] + list(T))  # includes period 0 for balance

    # production quantity
    model.x = pyo.Var(model.P, model.T, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)
    # end-of-period inventory
    model.I = pyo.Var(model.P, model.T, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)
    # shortage / undelivered amount
    model.s = pyo.Var(model.P, model.T, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)

    # Objective: minimize compensation + storage cost
    def obj_rule(m):
        comp = sum(d["comp"][p] * m.s[p, t] for p in m.P for t in m.T)
        hold = sum(d["hold"] * m.I[p, t] for p in m.P for t in m.T)
        return comp + hold
    model.obj = pyo.Objective(rule=obj_rule, sense=pyo.minimize)

    # Inventory balance: I[p,t-1] + x[p,t] + s[p,t] - I[p,t] = demand[p,t]
    def balance_rule(m, p, t):
        prev = d["init_inventory"] if t == 1 else m.I[p, t - 1]
        return prev + m.x[p, t] + m.s[p, t] - m.I[p, t] == d["demand"][p][t]
    model.balance = pyo.Constraint(model.P, model.T, rule=balance_rule)

    # Production time capacity per quarter
    def time_rule(m, t):
        return sum(d["hours"][p] * m.x[p, t] for p in m.P) <= d["time_capacity"]
    model.time_cap = pyo.Constraint(model.T, rule=time_rule)

    # Product I cannot be produced in quarter 2
    def forbidden_rule(m, p, t):
        return m.x[p, t] == 0
    model.forbidden = pyo.Constraint(
        [(p, t) for p, t in d["forbidden"].items()], rule=forbidden_rule
    )

    # Final inventory requirement at end of quarter 4
    def final_rule(m, p):
        return m.I[p, 4] >= d["final_inventory"]
    model.final_inv = pyo.Constraint(model.P, rule=final_rule)

    return model

    products = d["products"]
    periods = d["periods"]

    model.T = pyo.Set(initialize=periods, ordered=True)
    # extended period index including t=0 for initial conditions
    model.T0 = pyo.Set(initialize=[0] + list(periods), ordered=True)

    # Decision variables
    model.prod = pyo.Var(model.P, model.T, domain=pyo.NonNegativeReals)
    model.inv = pyo.Var(model.P, model.T0, domain=pyo.NonNegativeReals)
    model.short = pyo.Var(model.P, model.T0, domain=pyo.NonNegativeReals)

    # ---------- Objective ----------
    def obj_rule(m):
        storage = sum(
            d["holding_cost"] * m.inv[p, t] for p in m.P for t in m.T
        )
        penalty = sum(
            d["compensation"][p] * m.short[p, t] for p in m.P for t in m.T
        )
        return storage + penalty

    model.obj = pyo.Objective(rule=obj_rule, sense=pyo.minimize)

    # ---------- Initial conditions ----------
    def init_inv_rule(m, p):
        return m.inv[p, 0] == 0

    def init_short_rule(m, p):
        return m.short[p, 0] == 0

    def balance_rule(m, p, t):

            m.inv[p, t]
            == m.inv[p, t - 1]
            + m.prod[p, t]
            + m.short[p, t]
            - m.short[p, t - 1]

            <= d["time_capacity"]
        )

    # ---------- Final inventory requirement ----------
    def final_inv_rule(m, p):

    model.final_inv = pyo.Constraint(model.P, rule=final_inv_rule)

"""
Production planning with contract bookings, shortage compensation and storage costs.

DECISION VARIABLES
------------------
prod[p, t]  -- units of product p produced in quarter t
               domain: NonNegativeReals (units), index p in products, t in periods
inv[p, t]   -- units of product p held in inventory at end of quarter t
               domain: NonNegativeReals
short[p, t] -- units of product p booked in quarter t but not delivered in quarter t
               domain: NonNegativeReals

OBJECTIVE (minimize)
--------------------
Total compensation cost for undelivered units plus storage cost for held inventory:
  sum_{p,t} comp[p] * short[p,t]  +  sum_{p,t} hold * inv[p,t]

CONSTRAINTS
-----------
(1) Inventory balance for each product and quarter:
    inv[p,t-1] + prod[p,t] = booking[p,t] - short[p,t] + inv[p,t]
    i.e. previous inventory + production = delivered + ending inventory,
    where delivered = booking - short.
    Source: "if a product cannot be delivered on time, compensation ... storage cost".
(2) Initial inventory is zero: inv[p,0] = 0.
    Source: "At the beginning of the first quarter, there is no inventory".
(3) Final inventory requirement: inv[p,4] = 150 for each product.
    Source: "required to have 150 units of inventory for each product at the end
    of the fourth quarter".
(4) Production capacity per quarter: sum_p hours[p] * prod[p,t] <= 15000.
    Source: "the factory has 15,000 hours of production time per quarter".
(5) Product I cannot be produced in quarter 2: prod["I",2] = 0.
    Source: "product I cannot be produced in the second quarter".
"""

DATA = {
    "products": ["I", "II", "III"],
    "periods": [1, 2, 3, 4],

    # Table 1-10 booking quantities: booking[(product, quarter)]
    "booking": {
        ("I", 1): 1500, ("I", 2): 1000, ("I", 3): 2000, ("I", 4): 1200,
        ("II", 1): 1500, ("II", 2): 1500, ("II", 3): 1200, ("II", 4): 1500,
        ("III", 1): 1000, ("III", 2): 2000, ("III", 3): 1500, ("III", 4): 2500,
    },

    # Hours required to produce one unit of each product
    "hours": {"I": 2, "II": 4, "III": 3},

    # Compensation per unit per quarter for undelivered bookings
    "comp": {"I": 20, "II": 20, "III": 10},

    # Storage cost per unit per quarter
    "hold": 5,

    # Production time available per quarter (hours)
    "capacity": 15000,

    # Required ending inventory for each product at end of quarter 4
    "final_inv": 150,

    # Initial inventory at start of quarter 1
    "init_inv": 0,

    # Product that cannot be produced in a given quarter
    "forbidden": {("I", 2)},
}


def build_model(data=None):
    d = data or DATA
    m = pyo.ConcreteModel()

    products = d["products"]
    periods = d["periods"]

    m.P = pyo.Set(initialize=products)
    m.T = pyo.Set(initialize=periods)

    # Decision variables
    m.prod = pyo.Var(m.P, m.T, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)
    m.inv = pyo.Var(m.P, m.T, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)
    m.short = pyo.Var(m.P, m.T, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)

    # Objective: minimize compensation + storage
    def obj_rule(m):
        comp = sum(d["comp"][p] * m.short[p, t] for p in m.P for t in m.T)
        hold = sum(d["hold"] * m.inv[p, t] for p in m.P for t in m.T)
        return comp + hold

    m.obj = pyo.Objective(rule=obj_rule, sense=pyo.minimize)

    # (1) Inventory balance
    def balance_rule(m, p, t):
        prev = d["init_inv"] if t == periods[0] else m.inv[p, t - 1]
        return prev + m.prod[p, t] == d["booking"][(p, t)] - m.short[p, t] + m.inv[p, t]

    m.balance = pyo.Constraint(m.P, m.T, rule=balance_rule)

    # (3) Final inventory requirement
    def final_rule(m, p):
        return m.inv[p, periods[-1]] == d["final_inv"]

    m.final_inv = pyo.Constraint(m.P, rule=final_rule)

import pyomo.environ as pyo

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Structured formulation
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Sets / indices
#   P = {I, II, III}          products
#   Q = {1, 2, 3, 4}          quarters
#
# Decision variables
#   x[p, q]   production quantity of product p in quarter q
#             domain: NonNegativeIntegers
#   inv[p, q] end-of-quarter inventory of product p after quarter q
#             domain: NonNegativeIntegers
#   short[p, q] units of product p contracted in quarter q but not delivered
#             on time (compensated), domain: NonNegativeIntegers
#
# Objective (minimize)
#   total compensation cost for short deliveries
#   + storage cost for inventory held at end of each quarter
#
# Constraints
#   (1) Inventory balance for each product and quarter:
#       inv[p,q-1] + x[p,q] - inv[p,q] + short[p,q] = demand[p,q]
#       (initial inventory inv[p,0] = 0)
#   (2) Final inventory requirement: inv[p,4] >= 150 for each product
#   (3) Quarterly production time capacity:
#       sum_p hours[p] * x[p,q] <= 15000 for each quarter q
#   (4) Product I cannot be produced in quarter 2: x[I,2] = 0
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

DATA = {
    "products": ["I", "II", "III"],
    "quarters": [1, 2, 3, 4],
    "demand": {
        ("I", 1): 1500, ("I", 2): 1000, ("I", 3): 2000, ("I", 4): 1200,
        ("II", 1): 1500, ("II", 2): 1500, ("II", 3): 1200, ("II", 4): 1500,
        ("III", 1): 1000, ("III", 2): 2000, ("III", 3): 1500, ("III", 4): 2500,
    },
    "hours": {"I": 2, "II": 4, "III": 3},
    "capacity_hours": 15000,
    "initial_inventory": 0,
    "final_inventory_required": 150,
    "compensation": {"I": 20, "II": 20, "III": 10},
    "storage_cost": 5,
    "no_production": {("I", 2)},
}


def build_model(data=None):
    d = data or DATA

    model = pyo.ConcreteModel()

    model.P = pyo.Set(initialize=d["products"])
    model.Q = pyo.Set(initialize=d["quarters"])

    # Decision variables
    model.x = pyo.Var(model.P, model.Q, within=pyo.NonNegativeIntegers)
    model.inv = pyo.Var(model.P, model.Q, within=pyo.NonNegativeIntegers)
    model.short = pyo.Var(model.P, model.Q, within=pyo.NonNegativeIntegers)

    # Objective: compensation + storage
    def obj_rule(m):
        comp = sum(
            d["compensation"][p] * m.short[p, q]
            for p in m.P for q in m.Q
        )
        store = sum(
            d["storage_cost"] * m.inv[p, q]
            for p in m.P for q in m.Q
        )
        return comp + store

    model.obj = pyo.Objective(rule=obj_rule, sense=pyo.minimize)

    # (1) Inventory balance
    def balance_rule(m, p, q):
        prev = d["initial_inventory"] if q == d["quarters"][0] else m.inv[p, q - 1]
        return prev + m.x[p, q] - m.inv[p, q] + m.short[p, q] == d["demand"][(p, q)]

    model.balance = pyo.Constraint(model.P, model.Q, rule=balance_rule)

    # (2) Final inventory requirement
    def final_inv_rule(m, p):
        return m.inv[p, d["quarters"][-1]] >= d["final_inventory_required"]

    model.final_inv = pyo.Constraint(model.P, rule=final_inv_rule)

    # (3) Quarterly capacity
    def capacity_rule(m, q):
        return sum(d["hours"][p] * m.x[p, q] for p in m.P) <= d["capacity_hours"]

    model.capacity = pyo.Constraint(model.Q, rule=capacity_rule)

    # (4) No production of product I in quarter 2
    def no_prod_rule(m, p, q):
        if (p, q) in d["no_production"]:
            return m.x[p, q] == 0
        return pyo.Constraint.Skip

    model.no_prod = pyo.Constraint(model.P, model.Q, rule=no_prod_rule)

    return model
